site_name: Former Chase Park Depot, Off Rectory Lane, Whickham
evidence_slice: Gateshead Council's current planning committee report states that the Former Chase Park Depot site is allocated for housing under Making Spaces for Growing Places policy MSGP9.39 with an indicative capacity of 5 homes. The same report records that permission in principle DC/18/01012/BPIP established residential redevelopment of between 1 and 6 dwellings as acceptable in principle, and assesses a proposal for 4 dwellings. The official Gateshead Housing Site Allocations (MSGP9) FeatureServer layer is an esriGeometryPolygon layer supporting JSON, GeoJSON and PBF and was last edited on 28 October 2025.
